verdict.rationale: Zep's docs describe Graphiti, its temporal knowledge graph framework, as open source, with a public GitHub repo (getzep/graphiti) and community thanks for open-sourcing it. The managed Zep platform itself (zep-cloud, Memory MCP Server, governance features) is not shown to have open source, so only a component is readable. missing for 10: evidence that the core Zep service source is open, the specific open license named, independent confirmation of license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Graphiti is the open-source temporal knowledge graph framework.
Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents.
Thank you for open sourcing this! You are definitely onto something here.
